text:
eva: opened PR #8342 with migration guide + SDK snippets for Private. Heads-up: I pasted a demo config that includes a mock-looking ARN and an inline comment with a UUID. Need legal + sec quick review before main.
liam: Thanks. Drop the exact snippet here if you want me to scrub.
eva: snippet: ```yaml
private:
  kms: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/aa11-bb22-cc33
  service_account: 987fbc97-4bed-5078-9f07-9141ba07c9f3
```
security-bot: auto-detected sensitive pattern: arn:aws:kms and UUID-like id in the branch. Please replace with placeholders `<KMS_KEY_ARN>` and `<SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID>`. Also mark code block as non-executable (```text) so docs-bot doesn't try to run it.
docs-bot: note: preview linter will fail on executable blocks and broken anchors. Also warns about inline example comments that look like secrets.
liam: I'll prepare a follow-up commit to scrub and change the fence. eva: please add a short redaction checklist to the PR body so legal can track changes easily.
eva: pushed commit 4f7d9c: replaced strings with placeholders, code fence changed to ```text, added top-of-doc note: "This document contains placeholder identifiers. Do not paste production credentials."
ci-bot: preview failed: sensitive-check flagged a match in migration.md:58 (UUID pattern). Looks like the UUID was in a table row not the fenced block. See logs: https://ci.internal/job/8342/console
liam: found it in the compatibility table. I'll scrub and push again.
eva: pushed commit 4f7d9d: removed UUID from table and replaced with `<EXAMPLE_ID>`. Also updated PR description with commit hash and 1-line summary of redaction steps.
ci-bot: re-run triggered. preview passed for PR #8342  artifacts: https://ci.internal/job/8342/preview.zip
legal-review: quick check done. Placeholder text present and required top-line guidance is included. One request: add a short sentence saying customers should use KMS aliases or environment variables instead of embedding ARNs in code samples. Then ping legal again for final sign-off.
security-bot: agree with legal. Also suggest adding a ticket to add pre-commit sensitive pattern scanning for docs authors. Not blocking.
eva: added ops sentence and linked an internal ticket: DOCS-2125. Pushed commit 4f7d9e.
ci-bot: re-run triggered by 4f7d9e. preview passed.
liam: timeline question: can we merge to docs-staging before legal final sign-off if CI is green and placeholders applied? I want to run a canary on staging tomorrow morning.
legal-review: ok to merge to staging with the safeguards: (1) placeholders in place, (2) CI green, (3) PR description lists the redaction commit(s). Final legal approval needed before main.
eva: merging to docs-staging now. I'll tag legal for the staging review and add a note in the canary release: "PR #8342 - redaction applied; legal review pending final main merge."
docs-bot: merged PR #8342 to docs-staging by eva. Release note created.
ops: will schedule a canary deploy at 06:00 UTC and watch link telemetry. If anything leaks, we'll revert staging.
legal-review: we'll check the staging preview and provide final sign-off or request further redaction before main.
eva: thanks everyone. I'll open a short internal runbook for this redaction flow so authors follow the checklist next time. :thumbsup:
